name: Web Task Automation
description: Carry out a task on a website with the Browser plugin: plan the steps, read each page, act on the right element, check the result and ask before anything that sends.
abilities: Plans a web task as short steps before opening anything
Reads the page as text and acts on numbered elements, looking only when it has to
Checks after every step that the page did what was intended
Stops to ask before it submits, buys, sends, posts or deletes
permissions: Uses the Browser plugin, which you install separately
